title: Liberal Hypocrisy is Fueling American Inequality. Here’s How. | NYT Opinion
summary: NYT Opinion video essay arguing that Democrat-controlled states like California, New York and Illinois often fall short of their egalitarian values. It focuses on housing costs, homelessness, regressive taxes and school segregation as drivers of inequality.
why: Brought up in housing and zoning threads as a mainstream outlet making the case that progressive NIMBYism contradicts stated values.

quote.text: You cannot say you are against inequality in America, unless you are willing to have affordable housing built in your neighborhood.
